media.title: Ernst Lubitsch smoking a cigar — portrait photograph
media.description: Portrait photograph of film director Ernst Lubitsch smoking a cigar. Photographer unidentified; Fundo Correio da Manhã, Arquivo Nacional (Brazil), via Wikimedia Commons. The Commons metadata lists 1949, but that date requires caution because Lubitsch died in 1947.
